Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the phenomenon as “purification of an ore” (A) instead of the growth of a crystal (B). The observed cubic NaCl structures forming as water evaporates indicate crystallization/crystal growth, not ore purification or sedimentation. The Planner also gave an incorrect rationale (claiming heating reduces NaCl solubility) and prematurely finalized the task instead of selecting a specialist.
